# damR

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/vari-bbc/damR/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/vari-bbc/damR/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

Metabolomics analysis with limma

## Installation

You can install the development version of damR from
[GitHub](https://github.com/vari-bbc/damR) with:

``` r

devtools::install_github("vari-bbc/damR") # or
pak::pak("vari-bbc/damR")
```

# Package index

## Data import

- [`ReadFile()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/ReadFile.md)
  : Read and process input data file

## QC

- [`QCData()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/QCData.md) :
  Run QC on input data

### PCA

- [`GetPCA()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/GetPCA.md) :
  Compute PCA and variance explained
- [`PlotPCA()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/PlotPCA.md) :
  Plot PCA

### Extraction method filtering

- [`FilterExtraction()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/FilterExtraction.md)
  : Select the best extraction method for each metabolite

### Blank filtering

- [`FilterBlanks()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/FilterBlanks.md)
  : Blank filter data by batch

- [`GetBlankDropTable()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/GetBlankDropTable.md)
  : Identify data that falls under the provided threshold by batch
  across batches

- [`dropBlankFiltered()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/dropBlankFiltered.md)
  :

  Drop data that fails to meet the blank fold change threshold as found
  by
  [`GetBlankDropTable()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/GetBlankDropTable.md)

### Missingness

- [`RemoveMissing()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/RemoveMissing.md)
  : Remove missing data
- [`IdentifyMissing()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/IdentifyMissing.md)
  : Get metabolites where proportion present is less than a set
  threshold
- [`PlotMissingness()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/PlotMissingness.md)
  : Plot missingness heatmap
- [`impute.QRILC()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/impute.QRILC.md)
  : QRILC imputation

## Modelling

- [`DiffMetabolites()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/DiffMetabolites.md)
  : Get differential metabolites with log fold-changes and adjusted
  pvalues based on input comparison groups

### Helpers

- [`MakeTheContrasts()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/MakeTheContrasts.md)
  : Produce contrasts from comparisons

- [`FitTheData()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/FitTheData.md)
  :

  Fit model with limma across all.
  [`DiffMetabolites()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/DiffMetabolites.md)
  should be preferred to using this function directly.

- [`pAdjustData()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/pAdjustData.md)
  :

  Multiple testing correction within contrasts.
  [`DiffMetabolites()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/DiffMetabolites.md)
  should be preferred to using this function directly.

## Plotting

- [`VolcanoData()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/VolcanoData.md)
  : Produce volcano plot data for a single contrast
- [`PlotVolcano()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/PlotVolcano.md)
  : Plot volcano for a single contrast
- [`PlotAllVolcanoes()`](https://vari-bbc.github.io/damR/reference/PlotAllVolcanoes.md)
  : Plot volcanoes for all input contrasts
